title: The projection from a Galois field base change is a closed map
statement: For fields k and K with an algebra structure and IsGalois k K, and a scheme X over Spec k, the first projection from the pullback of X along Spec K -> Spec k is a closed map.

source.place: IsIntegralHom.SpecMap_iff and stability of universally closed morphisms under pullback

proof.text: The Galois extension is algebraic, hence algebraMap k K is integral. The spectrum map is integral by IsIntegralHom.SpecMap_iff, and integral morphisms are universally closed. Universal closedness is stable under base change, so the pullback projection is a closed map.

proof_origin.place: IsIntegralHom.SpecMap_iff and universally closed pullback stability
